description: Median and average price per square meter for a French commune and year, broken out by property type (Maison/Appartement), plus the total number of transactions. Computed only from single-lot sales (one parcel per transaction) with a positive built surface, because the DVF price field is the total for the whole transaction and would otherwise be double-counted or misattributed across bundled lots. Pass commune as a 5-digit INSEE code or a commune name; a name matching more than one commune (e.g. "Saint-Martin") returns the list of candidates instead of a number. Use for "median price per m2 in Lyon in 2024" or "how much do apartments go for in Nantes".

commune.description: 5-digit INSEE commune code (e.g. "69381" for Lyon 1er) or a commune name (e.g. "Lyon 1er Arrondissement", "Nantes"). A bare multi-arrondissement city name like "Lyon" or "Paris" returns all its arrondissements as candidates -- pass one commune.
